Cleared to Work

Licences, Approvals and Compliance

Holding, storing and moving sealed radioactive sources is the highest barrier to entry in this market. IXAR is authorised, certified and audited to do it in the region.

Radiation Safety Authorisation

Licensed to own, store, transport and operate sealed radioactive sources by the Uganda Atomic Energy Council and the Tanzania Atomic Energy Commission. Sources in use include Iridium-192, Selenium-75 and Cobalt-60, alongside X-ray and close proximity radiography systems. [Licence numbers and cross-border movement status to be confirmed]

Certified Personnel

Technicians qualified and certified to Level II and Level III in accordance with ASNT SNT-TC-1A. Level III personnel carry 7 to 25 years of field experience, Level II personnel 5 to 10 years. Qualified Radiation Protection Officers are assigned to all source handling work.

Quality Management

ISO 9001 certified since 2003. [Bureau Veritas registration reference to be inserted once the certificate is supplied] Written practices and procedures aligned to ASTM, ASME, API, BS, DIN and NACE, or to client specified standards.

Industry Standing

Member of the American Society for Non-Destructive Testing, the American Welding Society, ASTM, NACE, ISNT and NANSO. Regular member of the International Pipeline and Offshore Contractors Association (IPLOCA). Internationally recognised for environmental performance and occupational health and safety management.

Capability

Services We Offer

Over twenty NDT methods, delivered on site or in the workshop, with group specialists and equipment mobilised whenever a project calls for it.

Conventional Radiography (RT)

X-ray and gamma radiography using Iridium-192, Selenium-75 and Cobalt-60 sources, supported by mobile radiography units.

Read More

Digital and Computed Radiography

Digital image capture for faster interpretation, simpler storage and immediate sharing of results with the client.

Read More

Ultrasonic Testing (UT)

Thickness measurement, flaw detection and material characterisation across metals, plastics, composites and ceramics.

Read More

Advanced Ultrasonics

Phased array (PAUT), time of flight diffraction (TOFD) and automated ultrasonic testing (AUT) for weld inspection and accurate defect sizing.

Read More

Magnetic Particle and Liquid Penetrant Testing

Surface and near surface flaw detection on welds and components, carried out on site or in the workshop.

Read More

Eddy Current and Pulsed Eddy Current

Corrosion under insulation screening on carbon steel structures, and surface crack detection.

Read More

Pipeline Inspection

X-ray crawler radiography and automated ultrasonic testing of girth welds for cross country pipelines.

Read More
IMG-16Pigging unit photograph to supply

Pigging and Intelligent Pigging

Cleaning pigs to remove deposits and restore flow, and intelligent pigs to inspect and map pipeline wall condition.

Read More

Tank and Tube Inspection

Magnetic flux leakage inspection of tank floors and heat exchanger tubes for wall loss, pitting and circumferential cracking.

Read More
IMG-18Underwater inspection photograph to supply

Underwater Inspection

Inspection of jetties, dams, bridges and other submerged structures.

Read More
IMG-19Laboratory photograph to supply

Destructive Testing and Laboratory Services

Mechanical testing, chemical analysis, coating testing, corrosion testing and failure analysis.

Read More

NDT Training and Certification

Industry recognised training, including radiation safety certification for industrial radiographers, delivered in collaboration with the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre.

Read More
IMG-21Robotic crawler photograph to supply

Robotic and Remote Inspection

Crawler and remote access systems for confined, elevated or high temperature assets that cannot be entered safely.

Read More
IMG-22Heat treatment photograph to supply

Heat Treatment and Stress Relieving

Pre-heating, post weld heat treatment and stress relieving of welded joints and pressure equipment.

Read More
IMG-23Leak testing photograph to supply

Visual Inspection and Helium Leak Testing

Certified visual inspection, and helium leak testing for vessels, exchangers and sealed systems.

Read More
IMG-24Equipment photograph to supply

NDT Equipment Supply and Maintenance

Supply, calibration and maintenance of NDT equipment, with regional service support.

Read More
Sectors

Industries We Serve

Inspection programmes built around each sector's assets, standards and shutdown windows.

Oil and Gas

Pipelines, storage tanks, refineries and process plant across upstream, midstream and downstream operations.

Power Generation and Geothermal

Boilers, turbines, heat exchangers and steam pipework in thermal, hydro, geothermal and renewable facilities.

Mining

Structural steelwork, processing plant, pressure vessels and material handling equipment.

Cement

Kilns, ducting, structural supports and plant maintained within tight shutdown windows.

Breweries, Beverage and Food Processing

Tanks, vessels, process pipework and hygienic welded systems.

Sugar

Boilers, evaporators, mill structures and pressure equipment inspected during off-crop maintenance.

Marine and Ports

Jetties, cranes, hulls, mooring structures and submerged assets.

Manufacturing and General Engineering

Fabrication quality control, weld inspection, structural steel and pressure equipment certification.

Trusted By

The Group Behind the Region

Backed by Over 55 Years of NDT Experience

IXAR East Africa operates as part of Industrial X-Ray and Allied Radiographers (I) Pvt. Ltd., founded in 1969 and today a leader in non-destructive testing in India and internationally. The group employs over 1,000 technicians, holds ISO 9001 certification, operates a fleet of mobile radiography units, and runs a training institute accredited in collaboration with the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre in Mumbai. Regional teams draw on group equipment, technical specialists and written practices whenever a project calls for it.
